# VV Studios

> Podcast studio hire in South West Sydney for creators, businesses, entrepreneurs, and brands recording polished audio and video content.

VV Studios is a Vertigo Visuals podcast and content studio in Macquarie Fields, NSW. The studio is designed for video podcasts, interviews, marketing content, voiceovers, music recordings, remote podcast sessions, and social media content.

## Site

- Website: https://vertigovisuals.com.au/
- Sitemap: https://vertigovisuals.com.au/sitemap.xml
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vertigovisuals.au/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://vertigovisuals.com.au/): Overview of VV Studios, studio hire, features, testimonials, pricing, and FAQs.
- [Book a session](https://vertigovisuals.com.au/book): Book a podcast studio session by choosing a recording space, date, time, duration, and optional add-ons.
- [Pricing](https://vertigovisuals.com.au/pricing): Studio session pricing and production add-ons.
- [Gallery](https://vertigovisuals.com.au/gallery): Photos of the studio, podcast sets, lighting, cameras, and recording environment.
- [Contact](https://vertigovisuals.com.au/contact): Contact details, location, and free tour options.
- [Terms and conditions](https://vertigovisuals.com.au/terms-and-conditions): Booking, deposit, cancellation, conduct, delivery, and revision terms.
- [Privacy policy](https://vertigovisuals.com.au/privacy-policy): How booking, payment, website, and contact information is collected and used.

## Services and features

- Podcast studio hire in Sydney and South West Sydney.
- Video podcast recording with three 4K Sony cameras.
- Up to four RØDE PodMics.
- Cinematic overhead lighting.
- Experienced AV producer included with each session.
- Remote podcast recording support.
- Optional 4K UHD recording, essential editing, and social media clips packages.

## Pricing

- 1-hour studio session: $200 AUD.
- 2-hour studio session: $299 AUD.
- 3-hour studio session: $399 AUD.
- Remote podcast add-on: $59 AUD.
- 4K UHD recording add-on: $49 AUD.
- Essential Edit add-on: $99 AUD.
- Clips Package add-on: $79 AUD.
